title: Warranty Coverage Access Equipment Surcharge Schedule for Upper-Story Openings
content:
**Schedule.** On a technician visit whose trip charge Warranty Coverage bills, an access surcharge applies according to the installation job of the covered openings on the Installation Jobs records:

| Installation job of the covered openings | Equipment the visit needs | Access surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| carried an upper-story surcharge and used the Bay and Bow Installation method | a lift | 95.00 (lift access surcharge) |
| carried an upper-story surcharge and used any other method | ladders | 35.00 (ladder access surcharge) |
| carried no upper-story surcharge | — | none |

In clause form: when the installation job of the covered openings carried an upper-story surcharge and used the Bay and Bow Installation method, the visit needs a lift and takes the lift access surcharge; when that job carried an upper-story surcharge and used any other method, the visit needs ladders and takes the ladder access surcharge; a visit to openings whose job carried no upper-story surcharge takes no access surcharge.

## Both conditions together

| Upper-story surcharge on the job | Bay and Bow Installation | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 95.00 |
| yes | no | 35.00 |
| no | yes | none |
| no | no | none |

The upper-story surcharge is a fee booked on the installation job in the Installation Jobs records; the job is the one recorded on the Warranty Coverage registration.
